jobs.occupation: Global Key Account Manager Augmented Reality (m/f/d)* (Key-Account-Manager/in)

jobs.description: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/f/d)Kelvion- Our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionising refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.Together, We Shape the FutureYour responsibilities- Lead full-cycle recruitment efforts for selected specialist, management and senior roles in EMEA, with a particular focus on IT, Digital, Finance, Controlling, Accounting and Corporate Functions- Building relationships with Hiring Managers to understand the current and future needs of the business, helping to shape a proactive recruitment strategy accordingly, particularly for IT and Finance-related hiring needs- Actively developing talent pools through proactive searching and sourcing of talent using advertising, referrals, social media platforms, LinkedIn, professional networks, specialist communities and networking events- Creating and utilising best in class and innovative solutions to help fill niche and senior roles, especially in competitive IT, Digital and Finance talent markets- Managing the process with candidates from engagement to on boarding including offer process across all levels of the business, working with local HR teams ensuring compliance with all local employment law legislation- Securing talent that fits our company culture, adheres to the current needs of the business and role and future growth opportunities.- Acting as a true business partner to support local HR colleagues with recruitment opportunities, market insights and guidance on hiring feasibility- Proactively research market conditions, undertake competitor analysis, gain insight from peers, network, and via candidate relationships, including salary expectations, talent availability and competitor activity in relevant EMEA markets- Working with our Marketing team on recruitment branding, social media posts, and other ideas to raise our employer profile.- Enhancing our employee value proposition and refining our go-to-market strategy by collaborating closely with colleagues across the business- Driving the referrals program and networking events, with a focus on increasing access to qualified IT, Finance and Corporate Functions talent- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of research, reports, and intelligence in a centralized databaseYour profile- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification- Proven talent acquisition experience, minimum 5 years in search, agency, or in house, with a passion for the dynamic nature of recruitment including substantial time in house. Previous experience within search would be beneficial- Proven experience recruiting for IT and/or Finance roles, ideally across several EMEA markets- Experience working across the EMEA region and understanding of the regional talent markets- Solid understanding of typical profiles in IT, Digital, Finance, Controlling, Accounting or Corporate Functions- Deep knowledge of sourcing strategies and solid understanding of recruitment best practices incl. suitability diagnostics and structured candidate assessment methods- Excellent communication skills with the confidence to interact with candidates, colleagues, Hiring Managers and senior stakeholders- Prior experience in a manufacturing or products-based industry is highly desirable- Experience with ATS systems, e.g. SuccessFactors, and sourcing platform LinkedIn Recruiter- Fluent in English, written and spoken; additional European languages are a strong asset- An organised, adaptable, and proactive approach to talent acquisition with a strong sense of ownership and accountability- A passion for delivering a best-in-class candidate experience and continuously improving hiring strategies- The ability to document and present updates, market insights and candidate information with clarity, precision and flairAt Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. Within Kelvion creativity shines because people are listened to, their contributions recognised, and their ideas welcomed. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company.This is a fixed-term position for 12 months, offering the opportunity to contribute to Kelvion’s recruitment strategy with a strong focus on IT, Digital, Finance, Controlling, Accounting and Corporate Functions across EMEA.Together, We Shape the Future

With our well-known brands TOI TOI® and DIXI®, we provide essential services and innovative solutions to customers across a wide range of industries.As an international group, we are committed to continuously improving the way we work, embracing digital transformation and leveraging new technologies to drive operational excellence.Now, we are taking the next step in our digital journey - and AI will play a key role.We are looking for an ambitious and hands-on AI Transformation Manager (m/f/d) to help shape and drive our Group-wide AI initiatives. jobs.occupation: Packaging & Automation Engineer (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Verpackungstechnik)
jobs.description: Overview   At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.  We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams.  We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you.  At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact.  Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. ‎About the opportunity At QIAGEN, we are committed to making improvements in life possible. As a Packaging Engineer, you will play a key role in developing, industrializing, and continuously improving packaging solutions across our Diagnostics and Life Sciences portfolio. As a subject matter expert for packaging technologies, you will provide technical guidance to R&D, Operations, Quality, Procurement, manufacturing partners, and suppliers, ensuring robust, scalable, compliant, and cost-effective solutions throughout the product lifecycle. Combining packaging development, supplier engineering, manufacturing implementation, and automation, you will contribute to new product introductions, drive packaging innovation, and support automation projects across our global manufacturing and supplier network. Your tasks include * Leading packaging development and industrialization for new and existing products, from concept and material selection through qualification and commercial implementation.* Driving packaging automation projects at QIAGEN and supplier sites, including equipment implementation, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ activities.* Providing technical packaging expertise to R&D, Operations, Quality, Procurement, manufacturing sites, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.* Optimizing packaging materials and processes for product protection, quality, sustainability, regulatory compliance, efficiency, and cost.* Driving continuous improvement, root cause investigations, standardization, and the evaluation and implementation of innovative packaging technologies. Your profile * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.* Several years of relevant experience in packaging engineering, packaging development, manufacturing engineering, supplier engineering, or industrialization.* Strong expertise in packaging materials, technologies, manufacturing processes, and transport requirements, ideally including ISTA and IATA.* Experience with automated packaging equipment and equipment implementation, including FAT/SAT and DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ, preferably within a GMP or similarly regulated environment.* Experience managing technical projects and collaborating with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and cross-functional teams; experience in diagnostics, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, or life sciences is an advantage.* Knowledge of packaging qualification, risk management, FMEA, DoE, process capability, sustainability, and global manufacturing transfer is advantageous.* Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and stakeholder management skills, with fluent English; German is an advantage and occasional travel is expected.What we offer   * Bonus/Commission  * Local benefits   * Referral Program  * Volunteer Day  * Internal Academy (QIALearn)   * Employee Assistance Program   * Hybrid work (conditional to your role)  Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.    QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.
